subject: [PATCH v3 01/14] NFSD: cap the number of listeners accepted in listener_set

2026-08-28.patch_summary: This patch limits the number of listeners accepted in the listener_set function to prevent a userland request from spinning indefinitely due to an O(N * M) nested loop. The limit is set at NFSD_NL_LISTENER_MAX (1024), which is considered far above any realistic configuration. The patch also adds a check for oversized listener lists before taking any locks, ensuring that the system remains secure and responsive.
